LanguageData.LP_EK_WeaponBond.label: weapon bond
LanguageData.LP_EK_WeaponBond.description: Bind the weapon in your hands to yourself (replacing the previous bond): a bound weapon can't be disarmed. When not holding your bound weapon, summon the bound weapon on the same map back into your hands (the one in hand is put at your feet). No mana cost, cooldown 1 hour. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_EK_Shield.label: shield (eldritch knight)
LanguageData.LP_EK_Shield.description: For 10 seconds an extra arcane shield surrounds you, absorbing 20 × martial power damage first. Mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_EK_ThunderBlade.label: thunderous smite
LanguageData.LP_EK_ThunderBlade.description: Within 10 seconds, the next melee hit adds 12 × martial power blunt damage and knocks targets of body size 2 or less back 1 cell. Mana 1, cooldown 5 seconds. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_EK_AbsorbElements.label: absorb elements
LanguageData.LP_EK_AbsorbElements.description: For 1 hour, fire, cold and lightning damage taken ×0.5. Mana 1, cooldown 1 hour. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_EK_WarMagic.label: war magic
LanguageData.LP_EK_WarMagic.description: Passive: each Eldritch Knight spell you cast is immediately followed by another hit on a nearby enemy (a full melee resolution); two hits after learning spellblade storm. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_EK_ArcaneCharge.label: arcane charge
LanguageData.LP_EK_ArcaneCharge.description: Teleport to an empty cell within 12 cells (no line of sight needed). Mana 1, cooldown 15 seconds. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 11.
LanguageData.LP_EK_EldritchStrike.label: eldritch strike
LanguageData.LP_EK_EldritchStrike.description: Passive: after you hit an enemy in melee, spell damage it takes (fire, cold, lightning, psychic, arcane force) ×1.25 for 10 seconds. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 11.
LanguageData.LP_EK_Bladestorm.label: spellblade storm
LanguageData.LP_EK_Bladestorm.description: For 8 seconds, each melee hit fires a magic missile at another enemy within 3 cells (6 × martial power arcane force damage). Mana 3, once per day. Passive: max mana +2, war magic strikes twice instead. Eldritch Knight, fighter level 15.
LanguageData.LP_PW_PsionicStrike.label: psionic strike
LanguageData.LP_PW_PsionicStrike.description: For 30 seconds each melee hit adds 6 × martial power psychic damage. Grit 1 (neural heat 8 instead with a psylink), cooldown 30 seconds. Psi Warrior, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_PW_ProtectiveField.label: protective field
LanguageData.LP_PW_ProtectiveField.description: Passive: with a psylink, each hit taken ×0.7 while adding 4 neural heat (no effect if neural heat can't take it); without a psylink, each hit taken ×0.85. Psi Warrior, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_PW_TeleJump.label: telekinetic leap
LanguageData.LP_PW_TeleJump.description: Hurl yourself with telekinesis to an empty cell within 10 cells, ignoring obstacles. Grit 1 (neural heat 10 instead with a psylink), cooldown 10 seconds. Psi Warrior, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_PW_PsiAdept.label: telekinetic adept
LanguageData.LP_PW_PsiAdept.description: Passive: psychic sensitivity +15%, focus gained from meditation +25%. Psi Warrior, fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_PW_Shove.label: telekinetic thrust
LanguageData.LP_PW_Shove.description: One enemy within 15 cells has a 70% chance (40% for mechanoids) to be pushed back 3 cells and knocked down for 2 seconds. -5% success per level the target is above you, minimum 10%. Grit 1 (neural heat 10 instead with a psylink), cooldown 10 seconds. Psi Warrior, fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_PW_GuardianField.label: guardian field
LanguageData.LP_PW_GuardianField.description: Allies within radius 6 (including yourself) take ×0.5 ranged damage for 10 seconds. Passive: mind resistance +20%. Grit 2 (neural heat 30 instead with a psylink), cooldown 1 hour. Psi Warrior, fighter level 11.
LanguageData.LP_PW_TeleStorm.label: telekinetic storm
LanguageData.LP_PW_TeleStorm.description: All enemies within radius 8 are lifted by telekinesis and slammed down: stunned for 3 seconds, taking 15 × martial power blunt damage. Passive: max neural heat ×1.3. Grit 3 (neural heat 40 instead with a psylink), once per day. Psi Warrior, fighter level 15.
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodSpear.label: blood spear
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodSpear.description: Congeal your own blood into a spear and hurl it: one enemy within 25 cells takes 12 × arcane power piercing damage, ignoring 30% armor. The more you're hurt yourself, the higher the damage (+5% per 10% injury, up to +30%). Blood loss 8% (vampires: 10 hemogen), cooldown 5 seconds. School of Hemomancy, wizard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodBind.label: blood bind
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodBind.description: Seize the blood of an enemy within 20 cells: 65% chance to root it for 4 seconds (-5% per level the target is above you, minimum 10%). No effect on bloodless targets such as mechanoids and undead. Blood loss 8%, cooldown 15 seconds. School of Hemomancy, wizard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_HM_FleshShaping.label: flesh shaping
LanguageData.LP_HM_FleshShaping.description: On an ally within 15 cells: stitch up all bleeding wounds and heal 15 × arcane power. On yourself: no blood loss; instead blood loss is reduced by 20%. Blood loss 16% (free on yourself), cooldown 1 hour. School of Hemomancy, wizard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_HM_Siphon.label: blood siphon
LanguageData.LP_HM_Siphon.description: Passive: when you kill an enemy with blood, your blood loss -10% (vampires: hemogen +10). School of Hemomancy, wizard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodBoil.label: blood boil
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodBoil.description: Radius 3 at a point within 20 cells: enemies with blood take 4 × arcane power burn damage per second for 10 seconds (higher the more you're hurt yourself). Blood loss 24%, cooldown 1 hour. School of Hemomancy, wizard level 11.
LanguageData.LP_HM_FleshPrison.label: flesh lock
LanguageData.LP_HM_FleshPrison.description: Petrify the flesh of an enemy within 20 cells: 60% chance it can't move for 30 seconds (damage doesn't break it; -5% per level the target is above you, minimum 10%). No effect on mechanoids, the bloodless or body size over 2. Blood loss 24%, cooldown 1 hour. School of Hemomancy, wizard level 11.
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodRite.label: blood rite
LanguageData.LP_HM_BloodRite.description: Perform the blood rite on a nearby ally (or yourself), automatically picking what's needed most: regrow a missing part; with nothing missing, cure all diseases, addictions, chronic conditions and scars; with none of those, become 10 years younger (not below 18). Blood loss 30%, once per year. Passive: blood loss cap raised from 45% to 60%; for 5 seconds after each hemomancy cast, damage taken ×0.5. School of Hemomancy, wizard level 15.
LanguageData.LP_BS_SteelDefender.label: steel defender
LanguageData.LP_BS_SteelDefender.description: Build a steel defender from 100 steel + 2 components that aren't forbidden on the map (rebuilding within 1 day after it's destroyed costs only 20 steel); it takes you as its master and fights alongside you. If you already have a defender, recall it to your side instead. Cooldown 1 hour. Battle Smith, artificer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BS_BattleReady.label: battle ready
LanguageData.LP_BS_BattleReady.description: Passive: damage dealt with weapons +10%. Defender's guard: when you're attacked in melee, a steel defender right next to you has a 40% chance to block the hit. Battle Smith, artificer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_BS_ArcaneJolt.label: arcane jolt
LanguageData.LP_BS_ArcaneJolt.description: Passive: when you or your steel defender hit an enemy (once every 10 seconds), if there's an ally within 15 cells with over 30% injuries, heal the one who needs it most for 8 + artificer level; otherwise the target takes another 8 + artificer level arcane force damage. Battle Smith, artificer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BS_ImprovedDefender.label: improved defender
LanguageData.LP_BS_ImprovedDefender.description: Passive: steel defender armor +20%, melee damage +50%, damage taken another ×0.8, and it learns to haul. Battle Smith, artificer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_BS_MasterSmith.label: battle smith master
LanguageData.LP_BS_MasterSmith.description: Passive: can have 2 steel defenders at once; a defender automatically rebuilds the first time it falls each day (half its injuries healed); allies within 2 cells of a defender take ×0.8 damage. Battle Smith, artificer level 15.
LanguageData.LP_AM_CalmMind.label: soothe mind
LanguageData.LP_AM_CalmMind.description: Touch a friendly colonist having a mental break from anywhere on the map: 40% chance to end the break at once. Mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. Aberrant Mind, sorcerer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AM_PsychicSpike.label: psionic spike
LanguageData.LP_AM_PsychicSpike.description: One enemy within 25 cells takes 15 × innate power psychic damage; no effect on mechanoids. Mana 1, cooldown 5 seconds. Aberrant Mind, sorcerer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AM_PsychicDefense.label: psionic defense
LanguageData.LP_AM_PsychicDefense.description: Passive: mind resistance +25%, psychic damage taken ×0.5. Aberrant Mind, sorcerer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_AM_FleshRevelation.label: revelation in flesh
LanguageData.LP_AM_FleshRevelation.description: Grow tentacles for 1 hour: an extra melee attack (12 blunt), melee hits have a 30% chance to entangle the target for 2 seconds; movement +15%, wounds don't bleed. Mana 2, cooldown 2 hours. Aberrant Mind, sorcerer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_AM_MindDominion.label: psychic domination
LanguageData.LP_AM_MindDominion.description: One humanlike enemy within 20 cells has a 60% chance (-5% per level the target is above you, minimum 10%) to be dominated for 1 day: temporarily joins the colony and can be drafted. At the end, 30% chance it chooses to stay; otherwise it turns hostile again, is stunned for 10 seconds and flees. No effect on story bosses and legendary units. Mana 4, cooldown 3 days. Aberrant Mind, sorcerer level 15.
LanguageData.LP_CQ_ConqueringPresence.label: channel oath: conquering presence
LanguageData.LP_CQ_ConqueringPresence.description: Enemies within radius 6 (except mechanoids) have a 60% chance to be shaken and flee for 8 seconds (-5% per level the target is above you, minimum 10%). Channel Oath 1, no divinity cost. Oath of Conquest, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_CQ_GuidedStrike.label: channel oath: guided strike
LanguageData.LP_CQ_GuidedStrike.description: For 30 seconds, melee hit +50% and ranged hit +2% (per cell). Channel Oath 1, no divinity cost. Oath of Conquest, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_CQ_AuraOfConquest.label: aura of conquest
LanguageData.LP_CQ_AuraOfConquest.description: Passive: shaken or fleeing enemies within radius 5 move ×0.2 and take 8 × divine power psychic damage every 4 seconds. Oath of Conquest, paladin level 7.
LanguageData.LP_CQ_ScornfulRebuke.label: scornful rebuke
LanguageData.LP_CQ_ScornfulRebuke.description: Passive: melee hits against enemies not shaken have a 25% chance to shake them for 5 seconds; ×1.25 damage against already-shaken enemies. Oath of Conquest, paladin level 11.
LanguageData.LP_CQ_InvincibleConqueror.label: invincible conqueror
LanguageData.LP_CQ_InvincibleConqueror.description: For 1 hour damage taken ×0.5 (except holy damage), melee cooldown ×0.8. Divinity 3, once per day. Passive "Submission": humanlike enemies within radius 10 with over half their health lost (except bosses) have about an 8% chance every 4 seconds to drop their weapons and kneel in surrender, and can be captured directly. Oath of Conquest, paladin level 15.
LanguageData.LP_RD_EmissaryOfPeace.label: channel oath: emissary of peace
LanguageData.LP_RD_EmissaryOfPeace.description: For 1 hour social impact +30% and negotiation ability +20% (benefits recruiting, trading and comms console negotiation). Channel Oath 1, no divinity cost. Oath of Redemption, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_RD_RebukeViolent.label: channel oath: rebuke the violent
LanguageData.LP_RD_RebukeViolent.description: Valid for 1 day: the next enemy to hit you or an ally within 15 cells in melee takes holy damage equal to that hit (at most 30 × divine power). Channel Oath 1, no divinity cost. Oath of Redemption, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_RD_AuraOfGuardian.label: aura of the guardian
LanguageData.LP_RD_AuraOfGuardian.description: Passive: while drafted, when an ally within radius 5 is hit by an enemy, you take that hit instead (transferred damage ×0.75). Oath of Redemption, paladin level 7.
LanguageData.LP_RD_ProtectiveSpirit.label: protective spirit
LanguageData.LP_RD_ProtectiveSpirit.description: Passive: with over half your health lost, heal 1 × divine power every 4 seconds; mental break threshold -10%. Oath of Redemption, paladin level 11.
LanguageData.LP_RD_EmissaryOfRedemption.label: emissary of redemption
LanguageData.LP_RD_EmissaryOfRedemption.description: Passive: damage taken ×0.75 (except holy and psychic damage); enemies hitting you in melee take 4 × divine power holy retribution damage. Oath of Redemption, paladin level 15.
LanguageData.LP_RD_Reconcile.label: reconciliation
LanguageData.LP_RD_Reconcile.description: Reach out to the enemies of the whole map: each humanlike enemy (except bosses and prisoners) has a 40% chance to drop their weapon and leave, and their faction's goodwill +15. No effect on mechanoids and manhunters. Divinity 3, cooldown 15 days. Oath of Redemption, paladin level 15.
LanguageData.LP_DS_DragonBlood.label: dragon blood
LanguageData.LP_DS_DragonBlood.description: Passive: true dragon blood makes the body sturdier, Constitution +2 (applied after the cap). Draconic Soul, sorcerer level 4.
LanguageData.LP_DS_DragonFlight.label: dragon wing
LanguageData.LP_DS_DragonFlight.description: Passive: half flying, half walking: terrain, snow and plants no longer slow movement (impassable places like walls and deep water are still impassable). Draconic Soul, sorcerer level 10.
LanguageData.LP_DS_DragonPresence.label: dragon fear
LanguageData.LP_DS_DragonPresence.description: Passive: a frightful presence like a true dragon's. Enemies within radius 10 who can see you make a Wisdom save once (difficulty based on your Charisma): on failure they're frightened for 1 minute, and humanlikes may also panic and flee; success or not, the same person isn't checked again for 1 day. Mechanoids, undead, dragonslayers and others are immune. Draconic Soul, sorcerer level 14.
LanguageData.LP_FB_Eyes.label: blood cage: fiend's eyes
LanguageData.LP_FB_Eyes.description: On / off: Charisma +2 (+4 from level 8). While on, sorcerer max mana -2. Enhancements that can be on at once: 1 at level 4, 2 at level 8 (the permanently fixed one doesn't count). Fiendish Blood, sorcerer level 4.
LanguageData.LP_FB_Skin.label: blood cage: fiend's skin
LanguageData.LP_FB_Skin.description: On / off: skin turns red, wound healing ×1.5 and 0.5 injury regained every 4 seconds (×2 and 1 from level 8). While on, sorcerer max mana -2. Fiendish Blood, sorcerer level 4.
LanguageData.LP_FB_Tongue.label: blood cage: fiend's tongue
LanguageData.LP_FB_Tongue.description: On / off: psychic sensitivity +30% (+60% from level 8). While on, sorcerer max mana -2. Fiendish Blood, sorcerer level 4.
LanguageData.LP_FB_Awaken.label: bloodline awakening
LanguageData.LP_FB_Awaken.description: Passive: can maintain 2 body enhancements at once, and all enhancement effects are doubled (Charisma +4, healing ×2 with 1 regen, psychic sensitivity +60%). Fiendish Blood, sorcerer level 8.
LanguageData.LP_FB_Bound.label: flesh fixation
LanguageData.LP_FB_Bound.description: Passive: in the subclass window, pick one body enhancement to fix permanently: always on, not counting toward the limit, not reducing max mana; the other two toggle as usual. Fiendish Blood, sorcerer level 12.
